messages:
Maya: Quick reminder  were supporting alternate feedback and accommodation workflows this cycle (accessibility, caregiver needs, neurodivergent-friendly formats). Please read if you manage reviewers or submitters.

Jae: Awesome. What counts as an "alternate format"?

HR-Accessibility: Short list: (1) audio or video feedback uploads instead of free-text, (2) extended reviewer time windows (+72h), (3) screen-reader optimized export, (4) live interpreter or captioning for calibration meetings.

Noor: How do ICs request this? We need a low-friction path that preserves confidentiality.

Maya: Two options: (A) Employee requests via Accommodations Form link (private) OR (B) manager can submit on behalf with employee consent. Form: https://redwoodinference.internal/peopleops/accommodations.

Ben: If someone uploads audio feedback, does it go into calibration analytics? We rely on text parsing for signals.

ops-bot: Note: audio/video attachments are transcribed automatically (auto-transcript v1). Transcript used only for analytics and calibration sampling; original media stored encrypted with access limited to People Ops and the calibration panel on request.

Jae: What about small teams where anonymity breaks down? I worry about retaliation/perceived bias.

Maya: For teams <6, we offer anonymization: we can redact reviewer handles in the calibration packet and show only role/seniority. Managers must request anonymization via the form within the first 48h of feedback window. All anonymization requests are auditable.

Noor: Are accommodations visible to other managers? Privacy important.

HR-Accessibility: Accommodation flags are private by default. Console UI shows a non-specific badge ("has accommodations") only to People Ops and the employee's direct manager. Details require ops approval to view.

Ben: Logistics: captioning for calibration meetings  how do we schedule and budget?

Maya: Submit a caption/interpreter request at least 72h before your scheduled calibration slot. We budget on a case-by-case basis; People Ops will confirm and route to vendor. Request link on the meeting invite.

ops-bot: Accessibility exports updated: new CSV columns `accommodation_flag`, `accommodation_type` (limited tokens), and `feedback_media_transcript`. Access to these fields restricted via RBAC. Retention: transcripts 2 years.

Jae: Any impact on deadlines? If someone has an agreed +72h, how does that affect calibration freeze?

Maya: Accommodated items are excluded from the standard calibration freeze and instead have a separate "accommodation window" that closes 24h before calibration sampling. Managers will see an explicit note in the calibration UI.

Noor: Good. One more: can we get a short FAQ blurb I can share with my team about how to request and what to expect?

Maya: Will post a 3-bullet FAQ and a sample email template by EOD: https://redwoodinference.internal/peopleops/accom-faq. Tag @HR-Accessibility for review.

ops-bot: Ticket AC-3021 created for the accessibility rollout checklist. Automated reminder to managers without accommodation guidance acknowledged will send 48h before close.
